heading: Partnership program with institutions of higher education

children.heading: Hispanic-serving institution
children.text: The term “Hispanic-serving institution” has the meaning given the term in section 1101a(a) of title 20.

children.heading: Historically Black college and university
children.text: The term “historically Black college or university” has the meaning given the term “part B institution” in section 1061 of title 20.

children.heading: Tribal college
children.text: The term “Tribal college” has the meaning given the term “tribally controlled college or university” in section 1801(a) of title 25.

tree.heading: Partnership program
tree.text: The Commission may establish and participate in activities relating to research, mentoring, instruction, and training with institutions of higher education, including Hispanic-serving institutions, historically Black colleges or universities, and Tribal colleges, to strengthen the capacity of the institutions—

children.text: to educate and train students (including present or potential employees of the Commission); and
to conduct research in the field of science, engineering, or law, or any other field that the Commission determines is important to the work of the Commission.

notes.text: Amendments2008—Subsec. (a)(3). Pub. L. 110–315 made technical amendment to reference in original act which appears in text as reference to section 1801(a) of title 25.
